raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Some delivery batches (e.g. batch 12) send amount as a string with a '$' prefix, such as '$75.13'. The direct cast to DECIMAL(12,2) fails on these rows. The values are dollar amounts in USD, the same scale as the unprefixed rows, so stripping the symbol gives the correct value.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(amount), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
